It is designed to extend Ethernet transmission over any existing twisted-pair cable or telephone wires for distances up to 3,000m (9,843ft) into any point to point applications. What are Long Reach LAN Extenders? When building an IP network infrastructure, the distance problem, power supply, cable deployment network coverage are major issue of concern managers. To solve the above issues, Netsys launched a long-distance power supply solutions to meet today's needs that require long-distance transmission of data and power, this makes it a perfect and fast solution, lowering the total cost of remote networking implementation. The use of long-distance Ethernet VDSL2 technology combined with PoE technology enables IP network deployment over 100 meters (328 feet), which means that any IP infrastructure can be built in remote areas without having to worry about power supply and rewiring.
